description:
A medical physicist is auditing imaging protocols and needs to document the acquisition parameters of the CT Cranium dataset currently loaded in InVesalius.

Using the InVesalius interface, inspect the loaded CT Cranium data and extract the following acquisition parameters. Record them in a plain text file at /home/ga/Documents/ct_parameters.txt using 'key: value' format, one parameter per line:

1. slices: <total number of axial slices in the series>
2. matrix: <image matrix dimensions, e.g., 512 x 512>
3. pixel_spacing: <in-plane pixel spacing in millimeters, e.g., 0.957>
4. slice_thickness: <slice thickness or spacing in millimeters, e.g., 1.5>
5. modality: <imaging modality, e.g., CT>

Example format:
slices: 108
matrix: 512 x 512
pixel_spacing: 0.957
slice_thickness: 1.5
modality: CT

Find these values by inspecting the InVesalius application panels, import dialog information, slice viewer annotations, or any available metadata display. The values must accurately reflect the actual DICOM dataset properties.

The CT Cranium DICOM data from /home/ga/DICOM/ct_cranium should already be loaded in InVesalius when you start.
